_notes: Chalk-on-Ground Editorial: all lettering (and so every mark) is chalk white; yellow is reserved for the one outlined accent word and red for the footer lockup, so neither may touch a chart. The greens belong to the photograph.
Emphasis = solid chalk #F5F5EF vs faded chalk rgba(245,245,239,.42) (~#81866C over the shadowed ground #2D360D).

Validated with a local CIE-Lab/Machado script (the dataviz validate_palette.js was not installed): emphasis dE normal 43.2, deuteranope 42.8; contrast vs ground 11.69:1 (lit) and 3.39:1 (faded) - both >= 3:1.

Ordinal ramp = chalk mixed onto shadow green at 34/48/62/78/100%: luminance 0.129 -> 0.909, monotone, adjacent gaps >= 0.09. The darkest step is only 2.18:1 on the ground - relief: every mark in these charts carries a direct chalk label.
